newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania January services down 11 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Romania January services down 11 pct year-on-year.

text.p: Turnover from Romania's service sector dropped by an year-on-year 11 percent in January, data issued by the National Statistics Board (CNS) showed on Monday.
The CNS said hotel and restaurant businesses, which take 37.1 percent of the sector, fell 17 percent in January from the same month of 1996.
The private sector took 71.6 percent of January's services, down from 73.5 percent in the year-ago period, data showed.
Figures refer to commercial services to the population and exclude transport, mail and telecoms.
